chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him) in which he establishes the virtue of the noble Messenger.
ai.seo_question: What is the main theme of this sermon from Nahj al-Balagha regarding the Prophet?
ai.summary: This introductory note from Sharif al-Radi’s compilation frames the subsequent sermon within the context of the transition from the Age of Ignorance (Jahiliyyah) to the era of divine guidance, highlighting Imam Ali’s role in articulating the Prophet’s unique spiritual and moral stature. It sets the stage for a detailed theological exposition on how the Prophet’s character served as the living embodiment of the Quranic message, a central theme in Shia exegetical tradition.
